contexts.text: Ethiopia = similar things to Sheba. Illustrated.
Like things were signified by the queen of Sheba. AC 1171:5.
Under Dedan, see this reference. AC 3240.
Under Seba, see this reference.
Sheba () = the celestial and spiritual things thence, which are gold, and frankincense.
Celestial things signified by Sheba. Enumerated. The Knowledges of such things are properly Sheba.
Sheba = Knowledges and adorations, which are incense, and calamus (); here, those which are devoid of charity.
Sheba the son of Joktan () is not mentioned elsewhere in the Word.
From Sheba () = from the celestial things of love and faith.
The queen of Sheba coming to Solomon... () = the wisdom and intelligence which came to the Lord.
Sheba, in Beer-Sheba, see Shibah.
Sheba = Knowledges.
Gold from Sheba = the good of Knowledges. Illustrated.
Sheba and Raamah () = those in the Knowledges of celestial and spiritual things. AC 10254:5. AE 242:13. AE 717:10.
Sheba = chiefly those in the Knowledges of celestial things.
Gold of Sheba () = wisdom thence, ( = the good of love into which the Lord will lead them by Knowledges. AE 242:18.) ( = the good of charity. AE 328:15. AE 329:18.)
Sheba = where these Knowledges are.
Sheba = these Knowledges.
The kings of Sheba and Seba () = the interior and exterior goods of the natural man; Sheba, its interior goods; and Seba, its exterior goods.
See Arabia.
